links.outcome: Agent success rate on long-horizon EHR tasks requiring tool use, multi-step planning, and consequential actions
links.effect: Best model reached 46% pass@1; open-source models reached at most 19%, across 100 tasks averaging 27 tool calls.
links.quote: Across 13 proprietary and open-source LLM agents, the best-performing model achieves only 46% success rate (pass@1), while open-source models reach at most 19%, revealing a substantial gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of real-world clinical workflows.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates LLM agents on a new execution-grounded benchmark (PhysicianBench) for EHR workflow tasks, measuring model accuracy/success rates without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
